about: Hello, my name is Tricia Murray. I'm a wife, a homeschooling mom of five kids, and I run a small homestead. I use my cleaning skills to help my family financially. I already clean a few houses monthly, but I'm looking to add several houses to my schedule. I would love the opportunity to meet with you and possibly give you a quote on my services. Most of the houses I clean are just wanting the basics, such as: tidying up each room, dusting, vacuuming, mopping, cleaning the bathrooms, and wiping down the kitchen counters. I also have done, and will do, deep cleanings which include washing base boards, walls, inside of windows, and outside of cabinets. I hope I will be able to help you in the near future.
